Guide.title: How to split teams
Guide.intro: Paste the full signup list, confirm who is playing, then split into random teams.

attendance.title: Choose who is playing
attendance.description: Someone signed up but can’t make it? Uncheck their name to mark them as sitting out. The original list stays intact. Only checked players are assigned and copied. You’ll be prompted to split again after changing the lineup.
attendance.registered: {count, plural, one {# signed up} other {# signed up}}
attendance.excluded: {count, plural, one {# sitting out} other {# sitting out}}

paste.title: Paste the whole list
paste.description: Paste a WeChat signup list to detect player names. Common numbering formats work, or enter one name per line.

split.title: Split by shirt color or team count
split.description: Detect shirt colors from the signup text, or choose 2, 3 or 4 teams. Players are distributed as evenly as possible. Click again to reshuffle.

notes.title: Keep player notes
notes.description: Late arrivals, early departures and notes in parentheses appear beside each name and stay in the copied results.

copy.title: Copy and share the results
copy.description: Copy team names, player counts and lineups with one click. If automatic copying fails, select the displayed text and copy it manually.

Guide.reopenHint: Tap the cookie icon at the bottom right to open this guide again.

Roster.label: Signup message
Roster.placeholder:
In WeChat, press and hold the signup message → copy the whole message.
Paste it here as it is; no need to edit it or select just the names.

You can also use the Paste button above.
Roster.registeredCount: {count, plural, one {# player signed up} other {# players signed up}}
Roster.attendingCount: {count, plural, one {# player playing} other {# players playing}}
Roster.excludedCount: {count, plural, one {# player sitting out} other {# players sitting out}}
Roster.detectPrompt: Paste the signup list to split by the shirt colors in the message.
Roster.defaultColors: No shirt colors found. Teams will use white and blue.
Roster.detectedColors: Shirt colors: <colors></colors> → {count, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}}

Attendance.title: Choose who is playing
Attendance.help: Everyone is included by default. Uncheck someone to mark them as sitting out; check them again to include them.

Results.title: Teams
Results.emptyRoster: No list yet. Paste the whole WeChat signup message into the input box. Numbered lines are recognized as players, for example 1. Rain.
Results.noAttendees: No players are included. Check the players who are taking part in the lineup.
Results.rosterChanged: The lineup has changed. Please split the teams again.
Results.readyToSplit: The lineup is ready. Confirm who is playing, then select “Split into random teams”.
Results.unrecognized: No players were recognized in this text. One line reads: {sample}. Use a number, a separator and a name, for example 1. Rain.
